events.name: Florida Panthers at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Sam Reinhart scored a shorthanded goal and a power play goal to lead the Florida Panthers to a 5-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Reinhart scores twice to lead Panthers over Lightning 5-2

events.name: Anaheim Ducks at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored the go-ahead goal six minutes into the third period and got his second on an empty-netter, Lukas Dostal stopped 26 of the 27 shots he faced, and the Anaheim Ducks beat the New York Rangers 4-1 on Monday night to end a two-game...
headlines.shortLinkText: Gauthier scores twice as the Ducks beat the Rangers 4-1 to snap their two-game losing streak

headlines.description: — Brady Tkachuk scored 2:11 into overtime and the Ottawa Senators beat the Winnipeg Jets 3-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tkachuk scores in OT to give Senators 3-2 win over Jets

events.name: Nashville Predators at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Filip Forsberg scored his 12th career hat trick, leading the Nashville Predators to a 5-2 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsberg's hat trick leads Predators to a 5-2 victory over Blues

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Mikko Rantanen, Matt Duchene and Wyatt Johnston had a goal and an assist each and Casey DeSmith tied a Dallas record with his 11th consecutive game earning points as the Stars rallied past the Los Angeles Kings 4-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rantanen, Duchene, Johnston each have goal and assist as Stars beat Kings 4-1
